Trader Sven sells a Vyrewatch top, legs and shoes outfit for 1,950 coins, independently of the trade-enabled policy. An already-owned outfit can replace this supply action.
The scripted Temple Trekking route gives a knife via knapsack and a bronze axe from a zombie, then consumes three vines and three bridge logs; the axe and knife remain available for later phases.
Eight blisterwood logs grant eight 76-XP Woodcutting rolls. Seven are given to Vertida and one is consumed when crafting the blisterwood sickle.
One enchanted ruby sickle is constructed with chisel, Lvl-3 Enchant (cosmic plus five fire runes, 59 Magic XP), and a knife; the Ivandis flail is converted to Blisterwood flail.
